[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Tan Kirin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who was a renowned figure in medical science by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Biological Warfare" /> A professor at the [[Corellian Science Academy]] on his homeworld of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Kirin delivered a lecture series hosted by the [[Republic Medical Journal]] and the [[Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences]] shortly before the Empire [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] Corellia<ref name="FW" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref>> The lectures featured a presentation of a summary of his most recent publication, "''[[Replication of T-5 Progenitor Cells Using Isolated Bacta-Kolto Induction]]''", and a question-and-answer session.<ref name="FW" /> During the Battle of Corellia, Kirin requested the help of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to destroy the bioweapon [[smokescreen]], which the Empire was manufacturing in the captured factories of [[Ardus Industries]].<ref name="Biological Warfare" />
